<h1 id="连接器的分类">连接器的分类</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423111501040-2115753579.png" alt="图片处理需求" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="板到板连接器">板到板连接器</h2>
<p><strong>排针排母</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423111708209-40915954.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
应用场景：低端、大尺寸的智能设备，开发板、调试板等。<br>
<strong>金手指连接器</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423111936539-1440403574.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
使用场景：开发板、测试板，体积大且固定不动的设备(如电脑机箱接线)。<br>
<strong>FPC连接器</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423112107943-1800373159.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
使用场景：主板和副板的连接、主板和外设的连接、需要弯曲的线路、紧凑的产品空间。</p>
<h2 id="板到线缆连接器">板到线缆连接器</h2>
<p><strong>接线端子连接器</strong><br>
MX1.25MM 白色端子<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113043349-729683832.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113050687-533100323.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
2.0MM<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113214621-1728687286.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>2.54MM<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113238457-1794584870.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>3.81MM<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113313054-606059776.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
3.96MM<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113542649-137378431.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
5.08MM<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113603942-1424525343.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113845966-396831558.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>圆形连接器(航空插头)</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423113920790-2039201084.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><strong>VGA</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423143355621-1091035289.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>

<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423143955096-1048449328.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>

<p><strong>DP</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423144437069-955549616.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>DVI</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423144557021-32568529.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>1394</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423144657824-349076708.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423144833407-847871612.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>Ypbprs</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423144914934-1176674796.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423144937752-513501487.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>复合视频接口</strong><br>

<h3 id="usb连接器">USB连接器</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423145603010-1491168993.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423145622770-1930443889.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>

<h3 id="pcie连接器">PCIE连接器</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423145955583-1674783199.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="sata连接器">SATA连接器</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423150055248-212113463.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423150149530-1142249377.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="sas连接器">SAS连接器</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423150509002-1015469280.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="ddr连接器">DDR连接器</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423150632700-127549076.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="记忆卡连接器">记忆卡连接器</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423151230051-1336013130.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>标准SD卡连接器</strong></p>
<p>用于标准尺寸的SD卡，广泛应用于相机、摄像机等设备<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423151258598-556785790.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>Micro SD卡连接器</strong><br>
用于更小的Micro SD卡，常见于智能手机、平板电脑等便携设备<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423151508168-1408986604.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>TF卡连接器</strong><br>
与Micro SD卡兼容，通常用于更小型的电子设备中。<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423151508168-1408986604.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="电信与以太网连接器">电信与以太网连接器</h3>
<p><strong>RJ45连接器</strong><br>
用于连接各种网络设备，如计算机、路由器、交换机等<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423152341557-1684993174.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<strong>RJ11连接器</strong><br>
特点：RJ11水晶头通常只有6个凹槽和4个触点（6p4c），结构上比RJ45小。<br>
应用场景：主要用于电话线路连接，也用于连接电话和调制解调器。<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423152534344-298069214.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="ps2连接器">PS2连接器</h3>
<p>PS/2接口不支持热插拔，带电连接或断开设备可能导致接口或主板损坏,最初并主要用于连接键盘和鼠标，也可用于连接轨迹球、条形码扫描器、指纹读取器等输入设备，部分工业设备也使用PS/2端口进行数据输入输出</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423152707998-1765362808.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="音频接口连接器">音频接口连接器</h3>
<p><strong>AUX接口</strong><br>
AUX接口（辅助接口）是最常见的音频输入接口，通常用于耳机和音响设备。它的接头通常为3.5mm，传输模拟音频信号，适合大多数消费电子设备<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423153032367-332822141.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>RCA接口</strong><br>
RCA接口也称为莲花接口，广泛应用于家庭音响和多媒体系统。它通常有红色（右声道）、白色（左声道）和黄色（视频）插孔，适合传输模拟信号<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423153144814-2056924844.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>XLR接口</strong><br>
XLR接口是一种专业音频连接器，常用于麦克风和音频混音器。它具有平衡传输的特点，能够有效减少干扰，适合长距离传输<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423153221115-494944191.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>TRS接口</strong><br>
TRS接口（Tip-Ring-Sleeve）常用于耳机和音频设备，具有三个连接点，分别用于左声道、右声道和地线。它的外观通常为圆柱形，常见于3.5mm和6.35mm的插头</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423153326852-1531717428.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="射频连接器">射频连接器</h2>
<p><strong>SMA</strong><br>
主要用于传输射频信号，其标准特性阻抗为50Ω，标准版本的传输频率范围从直流（DC）至18GHz，而高精度版本的频率上限可达26.5GHz甚至更高<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423153913053-254825375.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>SMB</strong><br>
与传统的螺纹式SMA连接器相比，SMB采用推入式接口，体积更小，插拔更加方便，且具有良好的抗震性能。SMB连接器的工作频率范围通常为DC-4GHz，支持50欧姆和75欧姆两种阻抗<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154226255-1046180615.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<strong>SMC</strong><br>
SMC是SMB的螺纹式变形，其内部结构尺寸与SMB相同,工作频率0~11GHz,通常用于雷达、导航等<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154242955-971819151.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>MMCX</strong><br>
一种新型推入式连接器，也是目前应用中最小的一种连接器<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154439452-82781343.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>MCX</strong><br>
基本功能与SMB类同，但体积比SMB小1/3。<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154403674-1173075585.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>N</strong><br>
N系列采用螺纹对接互换，有50和75欧姆两种版本。工作频率0<sub>11GHz，可配接3</sub>12mm软、半柔和半刚性电缆，精密型N头甚至被应用到18GHz环境，典型的应用场景有局域网、测试设备、卫星等<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154451197-1176716296.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>BNC</strong><br>
BNC其工作频率0～4GHz，最大特点是连接方便，一般通过连接卡套旋转不到一圈即可连接好。它适用于频繁连接与分离的场合，是目前通用的产品，尤其在仪器仪表、网络和计算机领域应用广泛<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154542085-1480457811.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>1.0/2.3</strong><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154750607-250436024.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>7/16</strong><br>
7/16 DIN系列同轴连接器是一种较大型50欧姆阻抗的螺纹连接器，具有功率容量大、电压驻波比小，三阶交调性能优越、坚固稳定、低损耗等特点，且一部分具有防水结构，可用于户外作为中、高能量传输的连接器，广泛用于微波传输和移动通信系统中<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3327933/202604/3327933-20260423154843417-850495245.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="功率连接器">功率连接器</h2>
